# The Company Surveyed It Before

## Source

[[Old Bellwether]], unprompted, in Session 4.

## The Rumor (Verbatim)

That [[The Ambergris Company]] surveyed the marsh forty years ago and paid its surveyors
to forget it.

## Key Elements

- A prior survey
- Payment for silence

## What This Rumor Suggests

The Company's account of the current contract is incomplete at best.

## Quest Implications

Changes what [[Errand - Recover the Brass Astrolabe]] was really for.

## Related

- [[The Ambergris Company]]
- [[The Silt Accord]]
- [[Old Bellwether]]

## Player Notes

Corroborated in part by [[Ferrant Oake]], who said the accord was older than claimed.

## Notes

Two sources who have not met. That is the strongest thing the crew has.
